from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashFlowRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's 10-Q cash flow data needed to verify the task criteria."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company issuing the 10-Q")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The period ending date, expected in YYYY-MM format")
    financing_amount: float | None = Field(description="Signed value of net cash from financing activities (positive for provided, negative for used)")
    financing_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the financing amount, e.g. 'millions', 'thousands'")
    investing_amount: float | None = Field(description="Signed value of net cash from investing activities (positive for provided, negative for used)")
    investing_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of the investing amount, e.g. 'millions', 'thousands'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_flow_records: list[CompanyCashFlowRecord]
